prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / identity-preserve.
Asset type: one production-intent dialogue portrait redraw for a 74 x 100 pixel canvas, displayed at nearest-neighbor scale.
Primary request: Redraw Avi / 阿薇, stable actor BRY-NPC-AVI, as a mature grounded medieval woman in her mid-thirties. Image 1 is the identity reference ONLY: retain her blue tied headscarf, tousled dark brown forelocks, warm complexion and direct practical personality. Images 2–4 are approved pixel portrait STYLE and FACE SCALE anchors only. Do not copy their facial identity or their worried brow expressions.
Composition: EXTREME TIGHT HEAD CLOSE-UP, three-quarter face turned a little to viewer left. The head including scarf fills 96% of canvas height and 94% width. Top of scarf at top edge with 1 pixel margin, chin near 86% canvas height. Forehead-to-chin facial skin dominates center, at least 57% canvas height. Only 3–5 target pixels of bare neck and a tiny 6–8 pixel sliver of ochre adapted men's jacket collar over cream linen at bottom. No shoulders, no torso, no chest, no hands, no props. Preserve full top and cheeks, keep scarf knot compact.
Identity/expression: practical seamstress, alert, direct, a little impatient as she firmly states her own work. Uneven but mostly level decisive brows, SMALL half-lidded brown eyes, compressed straight mouth with one slightly raised corner, grounded maturity. She is not crying or grieving. Distinct sturdy oval face, short broad nose with clearly readable nose bridge/nostril plane, modest cheekbones, square-soft chin. Do not glamourize or make young/cute.
Medium: truly coarse low-resolution pixel-art appearance like the approved refs. Opaque hard-edged contiguous color clusters, readable nose and cheek planes, grouped locks of hair, 3-4 large scarf planes. Sparse purposeful pixels, no texture confetti, no smooth gradients, no antialiasing, no painterly blur. Aim for a coherent <=32-color temporary palette, warm ochre skin ramp and muted slate-blue scarf. Eyes have at most one tiny dark cream sclera sliver each; iris/lid must dominate, never bright white eyes. No uniform eyebrows of generic sorrow. No outlines thicker than necessary.
Backdrop: actual fully transparent background, hard clean silhouette. One isolated portrait, no label, no text, no frame, no board, no checkerboard painted into artwork, no extra characters. Generate large enough for faithful 74x100 nearest-neighbor technical export; the output will be labeled an imagegen-derived quantized candidate, not native pixel authorship.
